name: rosetta-long-primes
code:
use default

is_prime(value: int) -> bool =>
    value > 1 /\ ((2..value)
        |> take_while(divisor => divisor * divisor <= value)
        |> all(divisor => value % divisor != 0))

reciprocal_period(prime: int) -> int? =>
    let remainder mut = 1 in

    for length in 1::prime do
        remainder = remainder * 10 % prime

        if remainder == 1 then break length fi
    od

is_long(prime: int) -> bool =>
    reciprocal_period(prime) =~ prime - 1

long_primes(bound: int) -> Pipe[int] =>
    (2::bound) |> filter(is_prime) |> filter(is_long)

write_line("long primes up to 500:")
write_line("  {long_primes(500) |> join(" ")}")
write_line()

[500, 1_000, 2_000, 4_000, 8_000, 16_000, 32_000, 64_000]
    |> each(bound =>
        write_line("  long primes up to {bound,6:N0}: "
                   "{long_primes(bound) |> count(),5:N0}"))
